pages.text: $(thing)Artifact of the Hunger Path.$(br2)Worn as a chestplate (Right-click) or in the Curios «necklace» slot. While equipped, hunger is not consumed: neither for abilities, nor for Instincts, nor for movement in Spirit Form.
pages.title: Necklace of the Beyond

pages.text: If «eye» is disabled in Curios, the necklace is not rendered on the character, but still functions.
